reason_code_tips.13.1: Get a signed handover or a first-use record for every delivery.
reason_code_tips.13.2: Add a click-to-accept checkbox for renewal terms at checkout and send a reminder before each renewal.
reason_code_tips.13.3: Write down what is included at checkout and get a sign-off at each milestone.
reason_code_tips.13.6: Send the customer a refund confirmation the day you refund.
reason_code_tips.13.7: Show cancellation terms at checkout with a tick box and repeat them in the confirmation email.

C02.get_first: Proof the customer received or used the website, such as a sign-off email, a CMS login or a launch confirmation.
C02.request_text: We have a card dispute on website project INV-2026-041 (USD 4,950). Can you send any proof that the client received or used the site: a sign-off email, CMS login records or a launch confirmation?
C02.tip: Get written sign-off or a first-login record when you hand over a project.

C15.get_first: Proof that the person who cancelled was allowed to cancel for the booker, or the booker's own written confirmation.
C15.request_text: We have a card dispute on the group tour booked by Acme Holdings (USD 3,200). Can the booker confirm in writing that J. Whitfield was allowed to cancel on their behalf?
C15.tip: Record who may cancel a group booking and ask the booker to confirm cancellations in writing.

C05.tip: Reply to cancellation emails within a day and stop the renewal, or send a reminder before it renews.

C08.tip: Do not sell live sessions you cannot deliver. Refund or reschedule before the customer disputes.

C09.tip: Check word counts before you deliver and agree changes in writing.

C11.tip: Process refunds promised under your guarantee within the days you state and send a receipt.

C14.tip: Show cancellation terms at checkout with a tick box and repeat them in the booking email.
